candidates.title: Red Hat's OpenShift MCP gateway reaches general availability
candidates.summary: Red Hat reports production GA for its MCP gateway in Connectivity Link 1.5.
candidates.what_changed: Adds isolation, stateless sessions, prompts and resources, guardrails and security hardening.
candidates.why_it_matters: Teams running multiple agent-tool tenants have new gateway controls to evaluate.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Review tenant isolation, session handling, access policy and rollout compatibility before adoption.

evidence.claim_scope: Release and documented features, not operational performance.

signal.rationale: Material operational or API configuration implications.

deduplication.canonical_event: Adds isolation, stateless sessions, prompts and resources, guardrails and security hardening.
deduplication.material_delta: Adds isolation, stateless sessions, prompts and resources, guardrails and security hardening.

candidates.title: GitHub introduces REST APIs for Copilot model policies
candidates.summary: GitHub's October 19 changelog reports model policy REST API controls.
candidates.what_changed: Enterprise and organization administrators can retrieve and update model policies through GET and PATCH endpoints.
candidates.why_it_matters: Model governance can be audited and automated rather than managed only through interactive settings.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Inspect endpoint scope, permissions, and rollout defaults before automating model access.

evidence.claim_scope: Release and documented features, not operational performance.

signal.rationale: Material operational or API configuration implications.

deduplication.canonical_event: Enterprise and organization administrators can retrieve and update model policies through GET and PATCH endpoints.
deduplication.material_delta: Enterprise and organization administrators can retrieve and update model policies through GET and PATCH endpoints.

watchlist.title: AWS TorchNeuron PyTorch compatibility announcement
watchlist.summary: Secondary reporting describes a PyTorch-to-Trainium compatibility initiative.
watchlist.what_changed: A claimed migration path was announced but first-party artifacts were not verified in this pass.
watchlist.reason: Canonical dated AWS release and inspectable software artifacts not established.
promote_when: Confirm dated AWS announcement and inspect public code, installation or compatibility documentation.

watchlist.title: Claude Code plugin hook diagnostic improvements
watchlist.summary: A claimed patch adds reporting for skipped plugin hooks.
watchlist.what_changed: More explicit hook-skipping diagnostics are reported.
watchlist.reason: Exact release and change details not independently checked; narrower incremental change.
promote_when: Confirm primary changelog and material engineering consequences.

exclusions.title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on October 19
exclusions.reason: The September 18 announcement already set the retirement date; October 19 execution does not establish a new technical capability. Similar lifecycle notices evaluated in October 16 ledger.

exclusions.reason: Older September release; overlaps previously published September 25 MCP gateway story without a confirmed material delta.
